home_data: Thermoplastic felt is a technical material that softens and takes shape when exposed to heat, and is widely used in industry. The most common areas of use are listed below:
newsintro1: Sound-absorbing insulation, in doors, trunk, internal panels, as heat insulation resistant to overheating
newsintro2: Vibration-reducing coatings in washing machines and refrigerators, noise reduction in indoor air conditioner units
newsintro3: As a firm layer for upholstered furniture, in mattress structures
newsintro4: Thermal and sound insulation, as a lightweight component in wall, ceiling and floor structures
newsintro5: In air purification filters, in industrial dust collectors
newsintro6: Shock-protective layer, cushioning material between packaged products
